versos.hebraico: וַיְהִ֣י אַבְרָ֔ם בֶּן־תִּשְׁעִ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה וְתֵ֣שַׁע שָׁנִ֑ים וַיֵּרָ֨א יְהוָ֜ה אֶל־אַבְרָ֗ם וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלָיו֙ אֲנִי־אֵ֣ל שַׁדַּ֔י הִתְהַלֵּ֥ךְ לְפָנַ֖י וֶהְיֵ֥ה תָמִֽים׃

controles.web: When Abram was ninety-nine years old, Yahweh appeared to Abram, and said to him, “I am God Almighty. Walk before me, and be blameless.
controles.kjv: And when Abram was ninety years old and nine, the Lord appeared to Abram, and said unto him, I am the Almighty God; walk before me, and be thou perfect.
controles.livre: Quando Abrão tinha a idade de noventa e nove anos, o SENHOR lhe apareceu, e disse-lhe: Eu sou o Deus Todo-Poderoso; anda diante de mim, e sê íntegro.

versos.hebraico: וְאֶתְּנָ֥ה בְרִיתִ֖י בֵּינִ֣י וּבֵינֶ֑ךָ וְאַרְבֶּ֥ה אוֹתְךָ֖ בִּמְאֹ֥ד מְאֹֽד׃

controles.web: I will make my covenant between me and you, and will multiply you exceedingly.”
controles.kjv: And I will make my covenant between me and thee, and will multiply thee exceedingly.
controles.livre: E constituirei meu pacto entre mim e ti, e te multiplicarei em grandíssima maneira.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּפֹּ֥ל אַבְרָ֖ם עַל־פָּנָ֑יו וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר אִתּ֛וֹ אֱלֹהִ֖ים לֵאמֹֽר׃

controles.web: Abram fell on his face. God talked with him, saying,
controles.kjv: And Abram fell on his face: and God talked with him, saying,
controles.livre: Então Abrão prostrou-se com o rosto ao chão, e Deus falou com ele, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: אֲנִ֕י הִנֵּ֥ה בְרִיתִ֖י אִתָּ֑ךְ וְהָיִ֕יתָ לְאַ֖ב הֲמ֥וֹן גּוֹיִֽם׃

controles.web: “As for me, behold, my covenant is with you. You will be the father of a multitude of nations.
controles.kjv: As for me, behold, my covenant is with thee, and thou shalt be a father of many nations.
controles.livre: Quanto a mim, este é o meu pacto contigo: Serás pai de multidão de nações:

versos.hebraico: וְלֹא־יִקָּרֵ֥א ע֛וֹד אֶת־שִׁמְךָ֖ אַבְרָ֑ם וְהָיָ֤ה שִׁמְךָ֙ אַבְרָהָ֔ם כִּ֛י אַב־הֲמ֥וֹן גּוֹיִ֖ם נְתַתִּֽיךָ׃

controles.web: Neither will your name any more be called Abram, but your name will be Abraham; for I have made you the father of a multitude of nations.
controles.kjv: Neither shall thy name any more be called Abram, but thy name shall be Abraham; for a father of many nations have I made thee.
controles.livre: E não se chamará mais teu nome Abrão, mas sim que será teu nome Abraão, porque te pus por pai de multidão de nações.

versos.hebraico: וְהִפְרֵתִ֤י אֹֽתְךָ֙ בִּמְאֹ֣ד מְאֹ֔ד וּנְתַתִּ֖יךָ לְגוֹיִ֑ם וּמְלָכִ֖ים מִמְּךָ֥ יֵצֵֽאוּ׃

controles.web: I will make you exceedingly fruitful, and I will make nations of you. Kings will come out of you.
controles.kjv: And I will make thee exceeding fruitful, and I will make nations of thee, and kings shall come out of thee.
controles.livre: E te multiplicarei muito em grande maneira, e te porei em nações, e reis sairão de ti.

versos.hebraico: וַהֲקִמֹתִ֨י אֶת־בְּרִיתִ֜י בֵּינִ֣י וּבֵינֶ֗ךָ וּבֵ֨ין זַרְעֲךָ֧ אַחֲרֶ֛יךָ לְדֹרֹתָ֖ם לִבְרִ֣ית עוֹלָ֑ם לִהְי֤וֹת לְךָ֙ לֵֽאלֹהִ֔ים וּֽלְזַרְעֲךָ֖ אַחֲרֶֽיךָ׃

controles.web: I will establish my covenant between me and you and your seed after you throughout their generations for an everlasting covenant, to be a God to you and to your seed after you.
controles.kjv: And I will establish my covenant between me and thee and thy seed after thee in their generations for an everlasting covenant, to be a God unto thee, and to thy seed after thee.
controles.livre: E estabelecerei meu pacto entre mim e ti, e tua descendência depois de ti em suas gerações, por aliança perpétua, para ser para ti por Deus, e à tua descendência depois de ti.

versos.hebraico: וְנָתַתִּ֣י לְ֠ךָ וּלְזַרְעֲךָ֨ אַחֲרֶ֜יךָ אֵ֣ת׀ אֶ֣רֶץ מְגֻרֶ֗יךָ אֵ֚ת כָּל־אֶ֣רֶץ כְּנַ֔עַן לַאֲחֻזַּ֖ת עוֹלָ֑ם וְהָיִ֥יתִי לָהֶ֖ם לֵאלֹהִֽים׃

controles.web: I will give to you, and to your seed after you, the land where you are traveling, all the land of Canaan, for an everlasting possession. I will be their God.”
controles.kjv: And I will give unto thee, and to thy seed after thee, the land wherein thou art a stranger, all the land of Canaan, for an everlasting possession; and I will be their God.
controles.livre: E darei a ti, e à tua descendência depois de ti, a terra de tuas peregrinações, toda a terra de Canaã em herança perpétua; e serei o Deus deles.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֱלֹהִים֙ אֶל־אַבְרָהָ֔ם וְאַתָּ֖ה אֶת־בְּרִיתִ֣י תִשְׁמֹ֑ר אַתָּ֛ה וְזַרְעֲךָ֥ אַֽחֲרֶ֖יךָ לְדֹרֹתָֽם׃

controles.web: God said to Abraham, “As for you, you will keep my covenant, you and your seed after you throughout their generations.
controles.kjv: And God said unto Abraham, Thou shalt keep my covenant therefore, thou, and thy seed after thee in their generations.
controles.livre: Disse de novo Deus a Abraão: Tu, porém, guardarás meu pacto, tu e tua descendência depois de ti por suas gerações.

versos.hebraico: זֹ֣את בְּרִיתִ֞י אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּשְׁמְר֗וּ בֵּינִי֙ וּבֵ֣ינֵיכֶ֔ם וּבֵ֥ין זַרְעֲךָ֖ אַחֲרֶ֑יךָ הִמּ֥וֹל לָכֶ֖ם כָּל־זָכָֽר׃

controles.web: This is my covenant, which you shall keep, between me and you and your seed after you. Every male among you shall be circumcised.
controles.kjv: This is my covenant, which ye shall keep, between me and you and thy seed after thee; Every man child among you shall be circumcised.
controles.livre: Este será meu pacto, que guardareis entre mim e vós e tua descendência depois de ti: Será circuncidado todo macho dentre vós.

versos.hebraico: וּנְמַלְתֶּ֕ם אֵ֖ת בְּשַׂ֣ר עָרְלַתְכֶ֑ם וְהָיָה֙ לְא֣וֹת בְּרִ֔ית בֵּינִ֖י וּבֵינֵיכֶֽם׃

controles.web: You shall be circumcised in the flesh of your foreskin. It will be a token of the covenant between me and you.
controles.kjv: And ye shall circumcise the flesh of your foreskin; and it shall be a token of the covenant betwixt me and you.
controles.livre: Circuncidareis, pois, a carne de vosso prepúcio, e será por sinal do pacto entre mim e vós.

versos.hebraico: וּבֶן־שְׁמֹנַ֣ת יָמִ֗ים יִמּ֥וֹל לָכֶ֛ם כָּל־זָכָ֖ר לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶ֑ם יְלִ֣יד בָּ֔יִת וּמִקְנַת־כֶּ֨סֶף֙ מִכֹּ֣ל בֶּן־נֵכָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹ֥א מִֽזַּרְעֲךָ֖ הֽוּא׃

controles.web: He who is eight days old will be circumcised among you, every male throughout your generations, he who is born in the house, or bought with money from any foreigner who is not of your seed.
controles.kjv: And he that is eight days old shall be circumcised among you, every man child in your generations, he that is born in the house, or bought with money of any stranger, which is not of thy seed.
controles.livre: E de idade de oito dias será circuncidado todo macho entre vós por vossas gerações: o nascido em casa, e o comprado a dinheiro de qualquer estrangeiro, que não for de tua descendência.

versos.hebraico: הִמּ֧וֹל׀ יִמּ֛וֹל יְלִ֥יד בֵּֽיתְךָ֖ וּמִקְנַ֣ת כַּסְפֶּ֑ךָ וְהָיְתָ֧ה בְרִיתִ֛י בִּבְשַׂרְכֶ֖ם לִבְרִ֥ית עוֹלָֽם׃

controles.web: He who is born in your house, and he who is bought with your money, must be circumcised. My covenant will be in your flesh for an everlasting covenant.
controles.kjv: He that is born in thy house, and he that is bought with thy money, must needs be circumcised: and my covenant shall be in your flesh for an everlasting covenant.
controles.livre: Deve ser circuncidado o nascido em tua casa, e o comprado por teu dinheiro: e estará meu pacto em vossa carne para aliança perpétua.

versos.hebraico: וְעָרֵ֣ל׀ זָכָ֗ר אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא־יִמּוֹל֙ אֶת־בְּשַׂ֣ר עָרְלָת֔וֹ וְנִכְרְתָ֛ה הַנֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַהִ֖וא מֵעַמֶּ֑יהָ אֶת־בְּרִיתִ֖י הֵפַֽר׃ס

controles.web: The uncircumcised male who is not circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin, that soul shall be cut off from his people. He has broken my covenant.”
controles.kjv: And the uncircumcised man child whose flesh of his foreskin is not circumcised, that soul shall be cut off from his people; he hath broken my covenant.
controles.livre: E o macho incircunciso que não houver circuncidado a carne de seu prepúcio, aquela pessoa será exterminada de seu povo; violou meu pacto.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֱלֹהִים֙ אֶל־אַבְרָהָ֔ם שָׂרַ֣י אִשְׁתְּךָ֔ לֹא־תִקְרָ֥א אֶת־שְׁמָ֖הּ שָׂרָ֑י כִּ֥י שָׂרָ֖ה שְׁמָֽהּ׃

controles.web: God said to Abraham, “As for Sarai your wife, you shall not call her name Sarai, but her name will be Sarah.
controles.kjv: And God said unto Abraham, As for Sarai thy wife, thou shalt not call her name Sarai, but Sarah shall her name be.
controles.livre: Disse também Deus a Abraão: A Sarai tua mulher não a chamarás Sarai, mas Sara será seu nome.

versos.hebraico: וּבֵרַכְתִּ֣י אֹתָ֔הּ וְגַ֨ם נָתַ֧תִּי מִמֶּ֛נָּה לְךָ֖ בֵּ֑ן וּבֵֽרַכְתִּ֨יהָ֙ וְהָֽיְתָ֣ה לְגוֹיִ֔ם מַלְכֵ֥י עַמִּ֖ים מִמֶּ֥נָּה יִהְיֽוּ׃

controles.web: I will bless her, and moreover I will give you a son by her. Yes, I will bless her, and she will be a mother of nations. Kings of peoples will come from her.”
controles.kjv: And I will bless her, and give thee a son also of her: yea, I will bless her, and she shall be a mother of nations; kings of people shall be of her.
controles.livre: E a abençoarei, e também te darei dela filho; sim, a abençoarei, e virá a ser mãe de nações; dela surgirão reis de povos.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּפֹּ֧ל אַבְרָהָ֛ם עַל־פָּנָ֖יו וַיִּצְחָ֑ק וַיֹּ֣אמֶר בְּלִבּ֗וֹ הַלְּבֶ֤ן מֵאָֽה־שָׁנָה֙ יִוָּלֵ֔ד וְאִ֨ם־שָׂרָ֔ה הֲבַת־תִּשְׁעִ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה תֵּלֵֽד׃

controles.web: Then Abraham fell on his face, and laughed, and said in his heart, “Will a child be born to him who is one hundred years old? Will Sarah, who is ninety years old, give birth?”
controles.kjv: Then Abraham fell upon his face, and laughed, and said in his heart, Shall a child be born unto him that is an hundred years old? and shall Sarah, that is ninety years old, bear?
controles.livre: Então Abraão postrou-se com o rosto ao chão, riu, e disse em seu coração: A um homem de cem anos nasceráfilho? E Sara, já de noventa anos, há de dar à luz?

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אַבְרָהָ֖ם אֶל־הָֽאֱלֹהִ֑ים ל֥וּ יִשְׁמָעֵ֖אל יִחְיֶ֥ה לְפָנֶֽיךָ׃

controles.web: Abraham said to God, “Oh that Ishmael might live before you!”
controles.kjv: And Abraham said unto God, O that Ishmael might live before thee!
controles.livre: E disse Abraão a Deus: Que Ismael viva diante de ti!

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֱלֹהִ֗ים אֲבָל֙ שָׂרָ֣ה אִשְׁתְּךָ֗ יֹלֶ֤דֶת לְךָ֙ בֵּ֔ן וְקָרָ֥אתָ אֶת־שְׁמ֖וֹ יִצְחָ֑ק וַהֲקִמֹתִ֨י אֶת־בְּרִיתִ֥י אִתּ֛וֹ לִבְרִ֥ית עוֹלָ֖ם לְזַרְע֥וֹ אַחֲרָֽיו׃

controles.web: God said, “No, but Sarah, your wife, will bear you a son. You shall call his name Isaac. I will establish my covenant with him for an everlasting covenant for his seed after him.
controles.kjv: And God said, Sarah thy wife shall bear thee a son indeed; and thou shalt call his name Isaac: and I will establish my covenant with him for an everlasting covenant, and with his seed after him.
controles.livre: E respondeu Deus: Certamente Sara tua mulher te dará à luz um filho, e chamarás seu nome Isaque; e confirmarei meu pacto com ele por aliança perpétua para sua descendência depois dele.

versos.hebraico: וּֽלְיִשְׁמָעֵ֘אל שְׁמַעְתִּיךָ֒ הִנֵּ֣ה׀ בֵּרַ֣כְתִּי אֹת֗וֹ וְהִפְרֵיתִ֥י אֹת֛וֹ וְהִרְבֵּיתִ֥י אֹת֖וֹ בִּמְאֹ֣ד מְאֹ֑ד שְׁנֵים־עָשָׂ֤ר נְשִׂיאִם֙ יוֹלִ֔יד וּנְתַתִּ֖יו לְג֥וֹי גָּדֽוֹל׃

controles.web: As for Ishmael, I have heard you. Behold, I have blessed him, and will make him fruitful, and will multiply him exceedingly. He will become the father of twelve princes, and I will make him a great nation.
controles.kjv: And as for Ishmael, I have heard thee: Behold, I have blessed him, and will make him fruitful, and will multiply him exceedingly; twelve princes shall he beget, and I will make him a great nation.
controles.livre: E quanto a Ismael, também te ouvi; eis que o abençoarei, e lhe farei frutificar e multiplicar em grandíssima maneira; doze príncipes gerará, e dele farei grande nação.

versos.hebraico: וְאֶת־בְּרִיתִ֖י אָקִ֣ים אֶת־יִצְחָ֑ק אֲשֶׁר֩ תֵּלֵ֨ד לְךָ֤ שָׂרָה֙ לַמּוֹעֵ֣ד הַזֶּ֔ה בַּשָּׁנָ֖ה הָאַחֶֽרֶת׃

controles.web: But my covenant I establish with Isaac, whom Sarah will bear to you at this set time next year.”
controles.kjv: But my covenant will I establish with Isaac, which Sarah shall bear unto thee at this set time in the next year.
controles.livre: Mas meu pacto estabelecerei com Isaque, ao qual Sara te dará à luz por este tempo no ano seguinte.

versos.hebraico: וַיְכַ֖ל לְדַבֵּ֣ר אִתּ֑וֹ וַיַּ֣עַל אֱלֹהִ֔ים מֵעַ֖ל אַבְרָהָֽם׃

controles.web: When he finished talking with him, God went up from Abraham.
controles.kjv: And he left off talking with him, and God went up from Abraham.
controles.livre: E acabou de falar com ele, e Deus subiu da presença de Abraão.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּקַּ֨ח אַבְרָהָ֜ם אֶת־יִשְׁמָעֵ֣אל בְּנ֗וֹ וְאֵ֨ת כָּל־יְלִידֵ֤י בֵיתוֹ֙ וְאֵת֙ כָּל־מִקְנַ֣ת כַּסְפּ֔וֹ כָּל־זָכָ֕ר בְּאַנְשֵׁ֖י בֵּ֣ית אַבְרָהָ֑ם וַיָּ֜מָל אֶת־בְּשַׂ֣ר עָרְלָתָ֗ם בְּעֶ֨צֶם֙ הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֔ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר דִּבֶּ֥ר אִתּ֖וֹ אֱלֹהִֽים׃

controles.web: Abraham took Ishmael his son, all who were born in his house, and all who were bought with his money; every male among the men of Abraham’s house, and circumcised the flesh of their foreskin in the same day, as God had said to him.
controles.kjv: And Abraham took Ishmael his son, and all that were born in his house, and all that were bought with his money, every male among the men of Abraham’s house; and circumcised the flesh of their foreskin in the selfsame day, as God had said unto him.
controles.livre: Então tomou Abraão a Ismael seu filho, e a todos os servos nascidos em sua casa, e a todos os comprados por seu dinheiro, a todo homem entre os domésticos da casa de Abraão, e circuncidou a carne do prepúcio deles naquele mesmo dia, como Deus lhe havia dito.

versos.hebraico: וְאַ֨בְרָהָ֔ם בֶּן־תִּשְׁעִ֥ים וָתֵ֖שַׁע שָׁנָ֑ה בְּהִמֹּל֖וֹ בְּשַׂ֥ר עָרְלָתֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Abraham was ninety-nine years old, when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.
controles.kjv: And Abraham was ninety years old and nine, when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.
controles.livre: Era Abraão de idade de noventa e nove anos quando circuncidou a carne de seu prepúcio.

versos.hebraico: וְיִשְׁמָעֵ֣אל בְּנ֔וֹ בֶּן־שְׁלֹ֥שׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה שָׁנָ֑ה בְּהִ֨מֹּל֔וֹ אֵ֖ת בְּשַׂ֥ר עָרְלָתֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Ishmael, his son, was thirteen years old when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.
controles.kjv: And Ishmael his son was thirteen years old, when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.
controles.livre: E Ismael seu filho era de treze anos quando foi circuncidada a carne de seu prepúcio.

versos.hebraico: בְּעֶ֨צֶם֙ הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֔ה נִמּ֖וֹל אַבְרָהָ֑ם וְיִשְׁמָעֵ֖אל בְּנֽוֹ׃

controles.web: In the same day both Abraham and Ishmael, his son, were circumcised.
controles.kjv: In the selfsame day was Abraham circumcised, and Ishmael his son.
controles.livre: No mesmo dia foi circuncidado Abraão e Ismael seu filho.

versos.hebraico: וְכָל־אַנְשֵׁ֤י בֵיתוֹ֙ יְלִ֣יד בָּ֔יִת וּמִקְנַת־כֶּ֖סֶף מֵאֵ֣ת בֶּן־נֵכָ֑ר נִמֹּ֖לוּ אִתּֽוֹ׃פ

controles.web: All the men of his house, those born in the house, and those bought with money of a foreigner, were circumcised with him.
controles.kjv: And all the men of his house, born in the house, and bought with money of the stranger, were circumcised with him.
controles.livre: E todos os homens de sua casa, o servo nascido em casa, e o comprado por dinheiro do estrangeiro, foram circuncidados com ele.
